purpose: One contract between the launch engine that builds the artifact, the runtime that gates the preview, and the control plane that issues the independent validation receipt.

participants.launch_engine: Strategic-Minds-AI/x1-launch-engine produces the sitepack build artifact and its manifest
participants.runtime: Strategic-Minds-AI/x1-ai-hub-swarm-runtime verifies the manifest and the receipts on the preview worker
participants.control_plane: Strategic-Minds-AI/x1-ai-hub-control-plane reads execution evidence and issues the independent_validation receipt

artifact_digest.scope: sorted emitted file list, each entry path:sha256, newline joined, trailing newline

ready_requires: an independent_validation receipt bound to the same tenant, task, artifact digest and source SHA, issued by a VALIDATOR-class identity
deployment evidence whose preview URL answered 200 on a host inside the preview allowlist

acceptance.manifest_case: a real launch engine manifest for the pinned source SHA is accepted on its required keys, digests and gates alone
acceptance.receipt_case: a control plane independent_validation receipt bound to that manifest digest is accepted, and any mismatch of tenant, task, digest, SHA, issuer class or decision is refused
acceptance.evidence_case: the preview never reports PREVIEW_READY without verified deployment evidence
